observation_summary: The method forOffsetHoursMinutes incorrectly rejected negative minute offsets (e.g., -15) when the hour offset was 0, causing an IllegalArgumentException.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by an overly restrictive validation check on the 'minutesOffset' parameter. The fix involved expanding the valid range of minutes in the conditional check and adding a new guard to ensure logical consistency between hours and minutes. Since the primary issue was an incorrect conditional predicate, it is classified as Checking.
evidence_used: The stack trace shows an IllegalArgumentException: Minutes out of range: -15
The fix_diff_oracle shows the condition 'if (minutesOffset < 0 || minutesOffset > 59)' was changed to 'if (minutesOffset < -59 || minutesOffset > 59)'
The fix_diff_oracle shows an additional guard 'if (hoursOffset > 0 && minutesOffset < 0)' was added to enforce parameter consistency

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the calculation logic was also updated (using Math.abs), the root cause was the incorrect validation guard that prevented valid inputs from reaching the calculation logic.
